sentence: This project uses a murine model to study how a host's genetics shape its intestinal Lactobacillus population.
This project studies how uneven loss of gene products in triple-negative breast cancer changes the immune response and how to overcome resistance to treatment.
This project studies how aggrecan and perineuronal nets limit the flexibility of the visual system during the childhood critical period.
This project provides human tissues and analyses of lipoproteins, lipids and proteins to help study cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how radiotherapy affects rectal cancer by looking at the tumor, normal tissue, the microbiome and the immune system.
This project provides engineering and imaging services to follow early dissemination, dormancy and recurrence in mice and in cell-based studies.
This project studies how decorin interacts with its targets to make drugs based on decorin that limit corneal scarring and neovascularization.
This project collects and annotates gene expression data from mouse development so that researchers can find data sets of interest.
This project focuses on immune therapies for cancer and translational research to advance patient care.
This project tests a platform that finds which surface ligand-receptor pairs let extracellular vesicles move between human neurons and astrocytes.
This project studies how the transcription factor Foxp3 controls regulatory T cells and why defects in these cells lead to autoimmune and inflammatory disorders.
This project tests a single-session intervention with follow-up support through a chatbot for domestic violence survivors with posttraumatic stress disorder and depression.
This project studies how noncoding variants, which are DNA mutations that do not code for proteins, disrupt heart development and cause congenital heart disease.
This project builds databases and computational tools to predict and design how T cell receptors and antibodies recognize their targets.
This project builds genetic tools to tag and track lipids in brain cells and the synapse.
This project uses genetic approaches to find genes that cause birth defects in mammalian craniofacial development.
This project studies the biochemical pathways that protect kidney cells from injury in obesity and type 2 diabetes.
This project tries to find non-coding regions that are important for cell proliferation to uncover genetic variations linked to disease.
This project studies how demographic factors, social context and interpersonal experiences shape tobacco-related outcomes, affect and stress, using mobile health technology.
This project studies immune related genes with monoallelic expression and somatic drivers of disease to explain inborn errors of immunity.
